title: Package the editor binary to a stable path + document the interactive run recipe

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Added examples/editor/run.sh (builds via forge build --entry run, drops into raw-mode interactive, restores terminal on exit) + gitignored the build-output binary. Verified piped: hello+backspace+backspace+p+Ctrl-Q -> buffer help, exit 0.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: RESOLVED: examples/editor/run.sh builds (forge build --entry run --no-sandbox) + launches the editor (self-sets raw mode via extern-C termios; no stty). The editor builds+runs interactively (4277bf1, #90). The stable-path concern is superseded by run.sh + the self-contained binary. README documents the keymap + verified-vs-trusted split.
